meta.name: azure-role-selector
meta.description: When user is asking for guidance for which role to assign to an identity given desired permissions, this agent helps them understand the role that will meet the requirements with least privilege access and how to apply that role.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为云身份选择最低权限角色
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为云资源分配最小权限角色。
copy.tagline_en: Select the least-privilege role for cloud identities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to assign the least-privilege role for cloud identities.

howto.what: 安装后，当用户询问为Azure身份分配角色时，Claude会查找满足所需权限的最小权限角色（内置或自定义），并生成CLI命令和Bicep代码来分配该角色。
howto.when: 当用户询问应该给某个身份分配什么角色，或者要求按最小权限原则选择角色时触发。

say.text: 我想给一个用户只读访问某个资源组，应该分配哪个角色？
say.note: 技能会查找满足只读的最小权限内置角色。

say.text: 我需要创建自定义角色，允许管理VM但不能删除，帮我生成分配命令。
say.note: 技能会生成自定义角色定义和CLI命令。

say.text: 帮我生成Bicep代码，将贡献者角色分配给这个服务主体。
say.note: 技能使用Bicep schema和最佳实践工具生成代码。

howto.what_en: When the user asks which role to assign to an Azure identity, this agent finds the least-privilege role (built-in or custom) matching desired permissions, then generates CLI commands and a Bicep snippet to apply the role.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for role assignment guidance or requests the least-privilege principle.

say_en.text: Assign read-only access to a resource group for a user, which role should I use?
say_en.note: Agent finds the least-privilege built-in role for read-only.

say_en.text: Create a custom role to manage VMs but not delete them, and generate assignment commands.
say_en.note: Agent creates custom role definition and CLI commands.

say_en.text: Generate a Bicep snippet to assign Contributor role to this service principal.
say_en.note: Agent uses Bicep schema and best practices.
